subtitle: Out Cebu · Xiamen Airlines
overview: Fly Xiamen Airlines from Cebu via Jinjiang to Kunming, then travel by private bus with an English-speaking guide through Dali, Lijiang and back to Kunming. You will see Dali Old Town, Xizhou Ancient Town, Lijiang Ancient City, Jade Dragon Snow Mountain by cable car, Blue Moon Valley and the Naigu Black Stone Forest. All hotels are 4-star, and the tour ends with a night and a sightseeing stop in Quanzhou.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Cebu, Nov 24–Dec 1 2026 to Mar 13–20 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

itinerary.title: Cebu – Jinjiang (Quanzhou)
items: Arrive at Jinjiang Airport and meet the tour guide
Hotel check in (hotel arranged by Xiamen Airlines)

itinerary.title: Jinjiang – Kunming – Dali
items: Transfer to Jinjiang Airport and fly to Kunming (MF8409 07:45–10:40)
Arrive in Kunming and meet the tour guide
After lunch, drive to Dali and visit Santorini (Dali Ideal City) with afternoon tea (incl. uphill electric vehicle)

itinerary.title: Dali – Lijiang
items: Visit Xizhou Ancient Town, a Bai ethnic minority town
Visit Medicinal Herbs Exhibition Center (Medicine Store, shopping stop)
Optional: Dali Xizhou Music Caravan with singer performance, 1 drink, photo session (3 free digital photos), drone video (about 30 seconds free) and Bai ethnic “Golden Flower” dance: USD45/pax

itinerary.title: Lijiang
items: Jade Dragon Snow Mountain by Spruce Meadow cable car, and the large-scale live performance “Impression Lijiang”
Visit Blue Moon Valley (electric cart not included, USD9/pax)
Optional: dinner upgrade to Lijiang Imperial Banquet, price difference USD25/pax (regular seat) or USD40/pax (VIP seat); standard dinner is a group meal

itinerary.title: Kunming
items: Visit Naigu Stone Forest, the “Black Stone Forest”
Visit Park 1903, stroll the French-style district and try Kunming’s local food

itinerary.title: Kunming – Jinjiang (Quanzhou)
items: Hotel or packed breakfast and check out
Transfer to airport and fly to Jinjiang (MF8410 11:45–14:15)
Arrive at Jinjiang Airport and meet the tour guide

itinerary.title: Jinjiang – Cebu
items: Transfer to airport and fly home (MF817 14:20–16:55)

placeDesc.Jinjiang: A coastal city in Fujian next to Quanzhou, where the tour's flights connect.
placeDesc.Dali Ideal City (Santorini): A white, Greek-inspired seaside-style complex above Erhai Lake, visited with afternoon tea.
placeDesc.Dali Old Town: A walled old town in Dali with stone-paved streets, shops and cafes.
placeDesc.Xizhou Ancient Town: A town of the Bai ethnic minority near Dali, known for its traditional courtyard houses.
placeDesc.Lijiang Ancient City: The UNESCO-listed old town of Lijiang, with canals and cobbled lanes.
placeDesc.Jade Dragon Snow Mountain: A snow-capped mountain range above Lijiang, reached on this tour by cable car.
placeDesc.Spruce Meadow: A high-altitude meadow on Jade Dragon Snow Mountain reached by cable car.
placeDesc.Impression Lijiang: A large-scale live outdoor performance with the snow mountain as its backdrop.
placeDesc.Blue Moon Valley: A highland lake valley at the foot of Jade Dragon Snow Mountain.
placeDesc.Chuxiong Yi Ancient Town: A town built in the style of the Yi ethnic minority, visited on the drive back to Kunming.
placeDesc.Kunming Old Street: A restored old street in Kunming lined with traditional-style shops.
placeDesc.Nanping Street: A busy pedestrian street in central Kunming.
placeDesc.Jinma–Biji Archways: Two historic archways in Kunming that face each other across a city square.
placeDesc.Naigu Stone Forest (Black Stone Forest): A forest of dark limestone formations near Kunming.
placeDesc.Haigeng Dam: A dam on Dianchi Lake in Kunming, a scenic stop on the city tour.
placeDesc.Park 1903: A French-style district in Kunming for strolling and trying local food.
placeDesc.Kaiyuan Temple: A historic Buddhist temple in Quanzhou, visited on Day 7.
placeDesc.West Street: A pedestrian street in Quanzhou's old quarter.
placeDesc.Bell Tower: A landmark tower in the old centre of Quanzhou, visited with West Street.
